source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: In your Shooting phase, once this unit has shot, pick one enemy unit that is neither a MONSTER nor a VEHICLE and that was hit by at least one attack from its mole grenade launchers. Until your next Shooting phase begins, the Fire Overwatch Stratagem cannot target it. Designer's note: a Mole Grenade token beside that unit is a handy reminder.

select.condition: hit by one or more attacks made with a mole grenade launcher

fields.designerNote: use a Mole Grenade token as a reminder
